{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0
# This is the only valid way to compute change
valid_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0].copy()

# Recalculate change
valid_df['change'] = valid_df['biomarker_final'] - valid_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Now check the relationship between 'responded' and 'change'
# Count how many times responded = 1 when change > 0
responded_1_when_change_positive = (valid_df['responded'] == 1) & (valid_df['change'] > 0)
print("Responded = 1 and change > 0:", responded_1_when_change_positive.sum())

# Count how many times responded = 1 when change <= 0
responded_1_when_change_nonpositive = (valid_df['responded'] == 1) & (valid_df['change'] <= 0)
print("Responded = 1 and change <= 0:", responded_1_when_change_nonpositive.sum())

# Total responded = 1
total_responded_1 = (valid_df['responded'] == 1).sum()
print("Total responded = 1:", total_responded_1)

# Proportion of responded = 1 when change > 0
prop_correct = responded_1_when_change_positive.sum() / total_responded_1
print("Proportion of responded = 1 when change > 0:", prop_correct)

# Proportion of responded = 1 when change <= 0
prop_incorrect = responded_1_when_change_nonpositive.sum() / total_responded_1
print("Proportion of responded = 1 when change <= 0:", prop_incorrect)"}
